author: ProfessorUtonium
title: Is this real or some random kid?

replies.author: JJTheGuy
replies.body:
That's not a changed username though... 
That's a legit account. o.o

So either someone has an alt that has never been on Avicus, and changed its name to that, or a Yogcast dude is on. Or someone just bought an account and named it that.

Avicus only logs username changes that have logged on Avicus. These players could have changed their names before connecting to the servers.

Edit: Yup, these accounts joined 6 hours ago.
